mainEntity.name: Do I need to print my ticket?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. The QR ticket can be shown on your phone when entering the stadium.

mainEntity.name: How will I receive my ticket?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your Stripe receipt confirms payment. Your Petchyindee event tickets are then prepared and sent separately by MuayTix by email.

mainEntity.name: Is Petchyindee suitable for someone new to Muay Thai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. A first-time visitor can begin by watching how fighters use distance, timing, balance and control and how the contest changes as pressure builds.
